# Audio fixtures

The decoder tests (`tests/media/decode_tests.cpp`, label `media`) write their WAV, AIFF and AIFC
files at run time (`tests/media/AudioFixtures.h`). dr_libs can't write FLAC or MP3, so these two
files are the only audio committed to the repository:

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `sine-1k-48k-mono.flac` | 2571 | `2b32283e2df25681e65282b8f00ed4cad76cf44fad77123a6b21db5db6504d07` |
| `sine-1k-48k-mono.mp3` | 2688 | `d3399ab68846bafbb37ab25bc7c10360ca191302b82b9a8b7f6038985a265068` |

Both are made from the same generated WAV: 0.1 s (4800 frames) of a 1 kHz sine at half scale,
48 kHz, mono, 16-bit. It is gg-render's `sine` signal (`tools/gg-render/Signals.h`), amplitude 0.5,
with sample n = round(0.5 · 32767 · sin(2π · 1000 · n / 48000)). The 100 cycles end on a zero
crossing, so the file has no edge click. The tests check the FLAC against that formula within one
LSB and the MP3's RMS against the sine's within 1 dB.

They were made on macOS 27.2 (arm64), on 2026-10-28, with:

- Python 3.15.2 (Homebrew `python@3.15`) for the WAV;
- `flac 1.5.0` (Homebrew `flac`, `brew install flac`);
- `LAME 64bits version 4.0` (Homebrew `lame`, `brew install lame`).

```sh
python3 -I -c '
import math, struct, wave
w = wave.open("sine-1k-48k-mono.wav", "wb")
w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(48000)
w.writeframes(b"".join(struct.pack("<h", math.floor(0.5 * 32767 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 1000 * n / 48000) + 0.5)) for n in range(4800)))
w.close()'
flac --silent --best --no-padding --no-seektable -f -o sine-1k-48k-mono.flac sine-1k-48k-mono.wav
lame --quiet -m m -b 128 --cbr sine-1k-48k-mono.wav sine-1k-48k-mono.mp3
```

Running them again with these versions gives byte-identical files (the SHA-256s above). The WAV
itself isn't kept. Other encoder versions may give other bytes; the tests don't depend on the
exact bytes.

The fixtures are generated by the project and dedicated to the public domain
([CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)).
